text: 07900 - Joint Sealers 1.03 REFERENCES The following documents form a part of these specifications to the extent stated herein. Unless otherwise indicated, use the issue in effect on the date of request for quotation. Bring any conflicts between specifications, drawings, and the referenced documents to the attention of the University, in writing, for resolution before taking any related action. Where differences exist between codes and standards, the one affording the greatest protection shall apply. American Society for Testing and Material (ASTM) ASTM D 4258 Practice for Surface Cleaning Concrete for Coating ASTM D 4259 Practice for Abrading Concrete American Concrete Institute (ACI) ACI 308 Standard Practice for Curing Concrete 1.04 QUALITY ASSURANCE A. Applicator: Company specializing in elastomeric flooring applications with 5 years experience. B. Supervisor: Trained by product manufacturer. As-Built 09730-1 April 30, 2002 LLNL-TR-2004972 DWTF Phase 3B OCS-0069 C. The supervisor shall be at the work site during surface preparation and coating application operations. Provide coatings manufactured by a single manufacturer for all coating systems specified in this section. D. After each coating, following the manufacturer’s test standard to ensure dry film mil thickness and manufacturer’s recommended quality. 1.05 SUBMITTALS A. Submit product data, samples, and maintenance and operation data under provisions of section 01210. B. Product Data: Include manufacturer's preparation and installation instructions. C. Samples: Flooring samples 6 x 6 inch in size illustrating color and variation. D. Maintenance and Operation Data: Include procedures for stain removal, repairing surface, and cleaning. 1.06 ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS A. Do not install flooring when temperature is below 70 degrees F or above 90 degrees F. B. Maintain this temperature range, 24 hours before, during, and 72 hours after installation of flooring. C. Maintain relative humidity at a minimum of 25 percent and a maximum of 50 percent. D. Provide uniform lighting of at least 50 fc (540 lux) in area of installation. E. Restrict traffic from area where flooring is being installed or is curing. 1.07 DELIVERY, STORAGE, AND HANDLING A. Deliver products to site under provisions of Section 01210. B. Store and protect products under provisions of Section 01210. C. Store materials in a dry, secure area. D. Maintain minimum temperature of 60 degrees F. E. Keep products away from fire or open frame. As-Built 09730-2 April 30, 2002 LLNL-TR-2004972 DWTF Phase 3B OCS-0069 PART 2 PRODUCTS 2.01 MATERIALS A. All coats of flooring material shall be 100% non-porous material. B. Horizontal Application: 1. First Coat: 1/8” thickness of Chemproof Polymers “Permatec 3000” color yellow (no substitutions). 2. Second Coat: 1/8” thickness of Chemproof Polymers “Permatec 3000” color gray (no substitutions). 3. Top Coat: Chemproof Polymers “Permacoat 2000” color gray (no substitutions). 4. Truck Tank area is to have 12 mils, “Permatec 1100” installed as insulation membrane. C. Vertical Application: 1.
